title: Phase 0 benchmark result records
description: One JSON file per unit of work, written under $RESULT_DIR/json/. Three shapes, distinguished by filename prefix (partA__/partB__/partC). A non-JSON companion, $RESULT_DIR/mapsize_table.csv (bug,condition,target,map_bytes,binary_kb,fuzzminimizetime), is written once per (bug,condition) by cmd_partA and is the authoritative record of the real fuzzminimizetime decision per target — see mapsize_of_bin/pkg_map_bytes_measured in phase0.sh.

oneOf.title: partA trial record — one bug-rediscovery trial

duration_s.description: wall-clock time to first failure, or cap_s if censored

found.description: true iff go test reported --- FAIL before the cap

censored.description: true iff the trial hit cap_s with no failure. found and censored are never both true.

failing_input.description: path under testdata/fuzz/<Fn>/ to the minimized failing corpus entry; empty if not found

oracle_message.description: first line of the go test failure output; empty if not found

oracle_matches_bug.description: true iff oracle_message case-insensitively contains this bug's expected substring (see BUGS table's 5th field) — guards against counting an unrelated flake as a rediscovery

cpu.description: logical CPU this trial was taskset-pinned to (one of 0,1,2,3)

notes: A record with found=false and censored=false should not occur (rc!=124 and no --- FAIL and duration_s<cap_s) — treat as a script bug if seen.

Per the task's stopping rule: a bug is excluded from the headline stats entirely if either condition has more than half its runs censored — that check reads across all 10 records for (bug,condition), not stored per-record.

Bugs dropped before any trial ran (prove_revert failed, or build failed after revert) have NO partA json files at all for that (bug,condition) — check notes.txt for the drop reason, don't infer absence as 0 censored.

oneOf.title: partB mechanics record — one target/condition/rep throughput sample

wall_s.description: actual wall time of the go test invocation (should equal the requested -fuzztime plus build overhead)

execs.description: cumulative execs from go test's own last progress line

execs_per_s.description: execs / wall_s — recomputed, not the instantaneous rate go test prints (which trails toward the tick average near the end of a run)

map_bytes.description: REAL coverage-map size (distance between internal/fuzz._counters and internal/fuzz._ecounters in an instrumented `go test -c -fuzz='^Fuzz$'` binary), ported from fuzz-harness's own fuzz-runner.sh mapsize_of_bin/pkg_map_bytes (merged 2026-09-23). String type because the value is 'unknown' (not 0) when measurement fails — never conflate the two.

binary_size_kb.description: compiled test-binary size in KB — kept as an EXTRA labelled column per Andrei's request; this was the pre-correction proxy, now superseded by map_bytes for the actual fuzzminimizetime decision

notes: The identical-binary control run (partB_identical_control marker) is NOT written as JSON records — its two raw logs live at raw/partB-control-rep{1,2}.log; diff their parsed execs_per_s by hand or extend phase0_stats.py if this needs to feed the noise-floor calculation.

oneOf.title: partC record — build/footprint/attack-surface, BASE only, single file

build_s.description: plain build only; stripped build time not separately timed

syft_component_count.description: 0 if syft failed/unavailable — check raw/partC-syft.json and notes.txt before treating 0 as a real finding

system_route_count.description: distinct "/system..." string literals under server/http — a lower bound, not a route-table walk

proxy_handler_loc.description: total lines across every *_proxy.go under server/http

proxy_closure_rows.description: rows in docs/security-closures.tsv mentioning 'proxy' — a text-match proxy for the real count, not a component-tagged query; the tsv has no component column to filter on directly

notes: Runtime metrics (idle RSS/fds/goroutines, startup-to-/health, k6/vegeta load-scenario percentiles, CLI wall time cold/warm/local/remote) described in the task are NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in phase0.sh — flagged explicitly in the metric list/estimate for sign-off, not silently omitted from this schema. They would land as additional partC.json fields or a partC_runtime.json sibling.
